verdict.rationale: Cline has no first-party hosted cloud agent, but it can run headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline and chat from Slack or Linear. It can execute autonomously with auto-approve or YOLO mode, handle tests and dev servers live, and use a browser. Kanban adds isolated worktrees, auto-commit, and diff review with inline comments. Together these approximate a remote build-and-test-for-review flow on user-managed infrastructure. Missing for 10: a first-party managed cloud agent environment, a demo artifact such as screenshots, video or a preview deployment for the reviewer, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end runs in CI.
